mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_work_submission s JOIN public.nocode_work_draft d ON d.id = s.draft_id WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.source_type = #{source} AND s.material_json ->> 'objectId' = #{objectId} AND s.material_json ->> 'recordId' = #{recordId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_work_submission(id, draft_id, idempotency_key, request_digest, material_json, creator, updater) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.draftId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestDigest}, CAST(#{row.materialJson} AS jsonb), #{actor}, #{actor})
